name: Simulator: upgrading during a trial (S26) never shows a credit line
description: R4. Nothing was paid during the trial, so changing the price mid-trial must not produce proration lines.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S26 · Price change during a trial does not prorate' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Assert there are exactly 3 invoices with totals $0.00, $79.00 and $79.00
Assert no invoice line carries a 'proration' badge and no line amount is negative
